    .hero-buttons {

      gap: 16px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;

    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 14px 28px;

      font-size: 1rem;

      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(45,106,79,0.4);
    }

    .btn-secondary {
      background: var(--color-white);
      color: var(--color-primary);
      border: 2px solid var(--color-primary);
    }

    .btn-secondary:hover {
      background: var(--color-primary);
      color: white;
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    .hero-visual {
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .hero-image-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      grid-template-rows: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 16px;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 480px;
    }

    .hero-img-card {
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      aspect-ratio: 1;
      position: relative;
    }

    .hero-img-card:nth-child(1) { transform: translateY(-12px); }
    .hero-img-card:nth-child(4) { transform: translateY(12px); }

    .hero-img-placeholder {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;

      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 3rem;
      color: white;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .hero-img-card:nth-child(1) .hero-img-placeholder {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #A8E6CF, #88D8B0);
    }
    .hero-img-card:nth-child(2) .hero-img-placeholder {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFDAB9, #F4A261);
    }
    .hero-img-card:nth-child(3) .hero-img-placeholder {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFE4B5, #F4D35E);

    /* ========================================
       SECTION COMMON
       ======================================== */
    .section { padding: 80px 0; }

      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }

    .section-header h2 {
      font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 3vw, 2.25rem);

      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .section-header p {
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      color: var(--color-text-light);
      max-width: 560px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    /* ========================================
       FEATURED PRODUCTS CAROUSEL
       ======================================== */
    .featured-products {
      background: var(--color-white);
      padding: 80px 0;
    }

    .carousel-wrapper {
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .carousel-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 24px;
      transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);

    .product-card {

      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      transition: all var(--transition);

    .product-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px);

      padding: 20px;
    }

    .product-name {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      color: var(--color-primary-dark);
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .product-desc {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: var(--color-text-muted);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      line-height: 1.5;
      display: -webkit-box;
      -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
      -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .product-price {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      color: var(--color-primary);
    }

    .carousel-btn {
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--color-white);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);

      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      z-index: 10;
      transition: all var(--transition);

    .carousel-btn:hover {
      background: var(--color-primary);

      border-color: var(--color-primary);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    }

    .carousel-btn svg {
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
      stroke: currentColor;
      fill: none;
      stroke-width: 2.5;
      stroke-linecap: round;
      stroke-linejoin: round;

    .carousel-btn-prev { left: -8px; }
    .carousel-btn-next { right: -8px; }

    .carousel-dots {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: 32px;
    }

    .carousel-dot {
      width: 10px;
      height: 10px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--color-border);
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .carousel-dot.active {
      background: var(--color-primary);
      width: 28px;
      border-radius: 5px;
    }

    /* ========================================
       SEASONAL PICKS
       ======================================== */
    .seasonal-picks {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E8F5E9 0%, var(--color-cream) 100%);

      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr));
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .seasonal-card {
      background: var(--color-white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      transition: all var(--transition);
      position: relative;
    }

    .seasonal-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    }

    .seasonal-badge {
      position: absolute;
      top: 16px;
      left: 16px;
      background: var(--color-accent);
      color: white;
      padding: 4px 12px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      z-index: 2;

    .seasonal-img {
      height: 180px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 3rem;

    .seasonal-card:nth-child(1) .seasonal-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E8F5E9, #B2DFDB); }
    .seasonal-card:nth-child(2) .seasonal-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFF3E0, #FFCC80); }
    .seasonal-card:nth-child(3) .seasonal-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #EFEBE9, #D7CCC8); }
    .seasonal-card:nth-child(4) .seasonal-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFF8E1, #FFE082); }

    .seasonal-info {
      padding: 20px;
    }

    .seasonal-name {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      color: var(--color-primary-dark);
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .seasonal-desc {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: var(--color-text-muted);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    .seasonal-price {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      color: var(--color-primary);
    }

    /* ========================================
       CATEGORIES
       ======================================== */
    .categories-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .category-card {
      position: relative;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      aspect-ratio: 4/3;
      cursor: pointer;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .category-bg {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 3.5rem;
      transition: transform var(--transition);
    }

    .category-card:nth-child(1) .category-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFE0B2, #FFCC80); }
    .category-card:nth-child(2) .category-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #C8E6C9, #A5D6A7); }
    .category-card:nth-child(3) .category-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #B3E5FC, #81D4FA); }
    .category-card:nth-child(4) .category-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFCCBC, #FF8A65); }
    .category-card:nth-child(5) .category-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFF9C4, #FFF176); }

    .category-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(27,67,50,0.65);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity var(--transition);
      padding: 20px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .category-card:hover .category-bg { transform: scale(1.08); }
    .category-card:hover .category-overlay { opacity: 1; }

    .category-name {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      color: white;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .category-subtitle {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    /* Permanent bottom label visible without hover */
    .category-label {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(27,67,50,0.8), transparent);
      padding: 32px 16px 16px;
      transition: opacity var(--transition);
    }

    .category-card:hover .category-label { opacity: 0; }

    .category-label-text {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      color: white;
    }

    /* ========================================
       BRAND HIGHLIGHTS
       ======================================== */
    .highlights {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-primary-dark) 0%, var(--color-primary) 50%, var(--color-primary-light) 100%);
      padding: 64px 0;
      color: white;
    }

    .highlights-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 32px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .highlight-item {
      padding: 16px;
    }

    .highlight-number {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 900;
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem);
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      color: var(--color-accent);
    }

    .highlight-label {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1rem;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .highlight-desc {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      opacity: 0.8;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    /* ========================================
       STORE LOCATOR
       ======================================== */
    .store-locator {
      background: var(--color-white);
    }

    .locator-box {
      max-width: 640px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .search-form {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }

    .search-input {
      flex: 1;
      padding: 16px 20px;
      border: 2px solid var(--color-border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      font-size: 1rem;
      background: var(--color-cream);
      transition: border-color var(--transition);
      outline: none;
    }

    .search-input:focus {
      border-color: var(--color-primary);
    }

    .search-btn {
      padding: 16px 32px;
      background: var(--color-primary);
      color: white;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .search-btn:hover {
      background: var(--color-primary-dark);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .store-results {
      display: none;
    }

    .store-results.visible {
      display: block;
      animation: fadeSlideUp 0.4s ease;
    }

    @keyframes fadeSlideUp {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }

    .store-card {
      background: var(--color-cream);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 20px 24px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
      border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .store-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--color-primary);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .store-name {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1rem;
      color: var(--color-primary-dark);
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .store-address {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      color: var(--color-text-light);
      margin-bottom: 2px;
    }

    .store-hours {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: var(--color-text-muted);
    }

    .store-distance {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      color: var(--color-primary);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    /* ========================================
       NEWSLETTER
       ======================================== */
    .newsletter {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-cream) 0%, #E8F5E9 100%);
    }

    .newsletter-box {
      max-width: 520px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .newsletter-form {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-top: 32px;
    }

    .newsletter-input {
      flex: 1;
      padding: 16px 20px;
      border: 2px solid var(--color-border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      font-size: 1rem;
      background: var(--color-white);
      transition: border-color var(--transition);
      outline: none;
    }

    .newsletter-input:focus {
      border-color: var(--color-primary);
    }

    .newsletter-btn {
      padding: 16px 28px;
      background: var(--color-accent);
      color: white;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .newsletter-btn:hover {
      background: var(--color-accent-dark);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .newsletter-success {
      display: none;
      margin-top: 20px;
      padding: 16px;
      background: rgba(45,106,79,0.1);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      color: var(--color-primary);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
    }

    .newsletter-success.visible {
      display: block;
      animation: fadeSlideUp 0.4s ease;
    }

    /* ========================================
       FOOTER
       ======================================== */
    .footer {
      background: var(--color-primary-dark);
      color: white;
      padding: 64px 0 32px;
    }

    .footer-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 40px;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }

    .footer-col h4 {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1rem;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      color: var(--color-accent);
    }

    .footer-col ul {
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .footer-col a {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
      transition: color var(--transition);
    }

    .footer-col a:hover { color: white; }

    .footer-bottom {
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      padding-top: 24px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .footer-tagline {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
    }

    .footer-social {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .footer-social a {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
    }

    .footer-social a:hover {
      background: var(--color-accent);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    /* ========================================
       MOBILE NAV DRAWER
       ======================================== */
    .mobile-nav {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      right: -100%;
      width: 280px;
      height: 100vh;
      background: var(--color-white);
      z-index: 200;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
      transition: right var(--transition);
      padding: 80px 32px 32px;
    }

    .mobile-nav.open { right: 0; }

    .mobile-nav-overlay {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
      z-index: 199;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity var(--transition);
    }

    .mobile-nav-overlay.open { opacity: 1; }

    .mobile-nav-close {
      position: absolute;
      top: 20px;
      right: 20px;
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      color: var(--color-text);
    }

    .mobile-nav ul {
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .mobile-nav a {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      color: var(--color-primary-dark);
    }

    /* ========================================
       RESPONSIVE
       ======================================== */
    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .highlights-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .nav-links { display: none; }
      .mobile-menu-btn { display: flex; }
      .mobile-nav, .mobile-nav-overlay { display: block; }

      .hero-inner {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 40px;
        text-align: center;
      }

      .hero p { margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; }
      .hero-buttons { justify-content: center; }

      .hero-image-grid {
        max-width: 340px;
        margin: 0 auto;
      }

      .footer-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
        gap: 32px;
      }

      .search-form { flex-direction: column; }
      .newsletter-form { flex-direction: column; }

      .product-card { min-width: 220px; flex: 0 0 calc(50% - 12px); }

      .categories-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .section { padding: 60px 0; }
      .hero { padding: 60px 0 80px; }
      .highlights-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; }
      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .product-card { min-width: 200px; flex: 0 0 80%; }
      .categories-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .hero-buttons { flex-direction: column; align-items: center; }
      .footer-bottom { flex-direction: column; text-align: center; }
    }

    const nextBtn = document.getElementById('carouselNext');

    let currentSlide = 0;

    function getVisibleCards() {
      const w = window.innerWidth;
      if (w <= 480) return 1;
      if (w <= 768) return 2;
      if (w <= 1024) return 3;
      return 4;
    }

    function getTotalSlides() {
      const cards = track.children.length;
      const visible = getVisibleCards();
      return Math.max(1, cards - visible + 1);
    }

    function getSlideWidth() {
      if (!track.children[0]) return 0;
      const card = track.children[0];
      const style = getComputedStyle(track);
      const gap = parseInt(style.gap) || 24;
      return card.offsetWidth + gap;
    }

    function updateCarousel() {
      const total = getTotalSlides();
      if (currentSlide >= total) currentSlide = total - 1;
      if (currentSlide < 0) currentSlide = 0;
      const offset = currentSlide * getSlideWidth();
      track.style.transform = `translateX(-${offset}px)`;

      prevBtn.style.opacity = currentSlide === 0 ? '0.4' : '1';
      prevBtn.style.pointerEvents = currentSlide === 0 ? 'none' : 'auto';
      nextBtn.style.opacity = currentSlide >= total - 1 ? '0.4' : '1';
      nextBtn.style.pointerEvents = currentSlide >= total - 1 ? 'none' : 'auto';

      renderDots();
    }

    function renderDots() {
      const total = getTotalSlides();
      dotsContainer.innerHTML = '';
      for (let i = 0; i < total; i++) {
        const dot = document.createElement('button');
        dot.className = 'carousel-dot' + (i === currentSlide ? ' active' : '');
        dot.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Go to slide ' + (i + 1));
        dot.addEventListener('click', () => { currentSlide = i; updateCarousel(); });
        dotsContainer.appendChild(dot);
      }
    }

    prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { currentSlide--; updateCarousel(); });
    nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { currentSlide++; updateCarousel(); });
    window.addEventListener('resize', updateCarousel);
    updateCarousel();

    // Touch/swipe support for carousel
    let touchStartX = 0;
    let touchEndX = 0;
    track.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { touchStartX = e.changedTouches[0].screenX; }, { passive: true });
    track.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
      touchEndX = e.changedTouches[0].screenX;
      const diff = touchStartX - touchEndX;
      if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
        if (diff > 0) { currentSlide++; }
        else { currentSlide--; }
        updateCarousel();
      }
    }, { passive: true });

    // Store Locator
    const storeForm = document.getElementById('storeSearchForm');
    const storeResults = document.getElementById('storeResults');
    const zipInput = document.getElementById('zipInput');

    // Header scroll effect
    const header = document.getElementById('header');
    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      header.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 10);
    });

    // Mobile menu
    const mobileMenuBtn = document.getElementById('mobileMenuBtn');
    const mobileNav = document.getElementById('mobileNav');
    const mobileOverlay = document.getElementById('mobileOverlay');
    const mobileNavClose = document.getElementById('mobileNavClose');
    const mobileLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-link');

    function openMobileMenu() {
      mobileNav.classList.add('open');
      mobileOverlay.classList.add('open');
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    }
    function closeMobileMenu() {
      mobileNav.classList.remove('open');
      mobileOverlay.classList.remove('open');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }

    mobileMenuBtn.addEventListener('click', openMobileMenu);
    mobileNavClose.addEventListener('click', closeMobileMenu);
    mobileOverlay.addEventListener('click', closeMobileMenu);
    mobileLinks.forEach(link => link.addEventListener('click', closeMobileMenu));

    // Product Carousel
    const track = document.getElementById('carouselTrack');
    const prevBtn = document.getElementById('carouselPrev');
    const nextBtn = document.getElementById('carouselNext');
    const dotsContainer = document.getElementById('carouselDots');
    let currentSlide = 0;

    function getVisibleCards() {
      const w = window.innerWidth;
      if (w <= 480) return 1;
      if (w <= 768) return 2;
      if (w <= 1024) return 3;
      return 4;
    }

    function getTotalSlides() {
      const cards = track.children.length;
      const visible = getVisibleCards();
      return Math.max(1, cards - visible + 1);
    }

    function getSlideWidth() {
      if (!track.children[0]) return 0;
      const card = track.children[0];
      const style = getComputedStyle(track);
      const gap = parseInt(style.gap) || 24;
      return card.offsetWidth + gap;
    }

    function updateCarousel() {
      const total = getTotalSlides();
      if (currentSlide >= total) currentSlide = total - 1;
      if (currentSlide < 0) currentSlide = 0;
      const offset = currentSlide * getSlideWidth();
      track.style.transform = `translateX(-${offset}px)`;

      prevBtn.style.opacity = currentSlide === 0 ? '0.4' : '1';
      prevBtn.style.pointerEvents = currentSlide === 0 ? 'none' : 'auto';
      nextBtn.style.opacity = currentSlide >= total - 1 ? '0.4' : '1';
      nextBtn.style.pointerEvents = currentSlide >= total - 1 ? 'none' : 'auto';

      renderDots();
    }

    function renderDots() {
      const total = getTotalSlides();
      dotsContainer.innerHTML = '';
      for (let i = 0; i < total; i++) {
        const dot = document.createElement('button');
        dot.className = 'carousel-dot' + (i === currentSlide ? ' active' : '');
        dot.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Go to slide ' + (i + 1));
        dot.addEventListener('click', () => { currentSlide = i; updateCarousel(); });
        dotsContainer.appendChild(dot);
      }
    }

    prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { currentSlide--; updateCarousel(); });
    nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { currentSlide++; updateCarousel(); });
    window.addEventListener('resize', updateCarousel);
    updateCarousel();

    // Touch/swipe support for carousel
    let touchStartX = 0;
    let touchEndX = 0;
    track.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { touchStartX = e.changedTouches[0].screenX; }, { passive: true });
    track.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
      touchEndX = e.changedTouches[0].screenX;
      const diff = touchStartX - touchEndX;
      if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
        if (diff > 0) { currentSlide++; }
        else { currentSlide--; }
        updateCarousel();
      }
    }, { passive: true });

    // Store Locator
    const storeForm = document.getElementById('storeSearchForm');
    const storeResults = document.getElementById('storeResults');
    const zipInput = document.getElementById('zipInput');

    storeForm.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const zip = zipInput.value.trim();
      if (zip.length > 0) {
        storeResults.classList.add('visible');
        storeResults.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
      }
    });

    // Newsletter
    const newsletterForm = document.getElementById('newsletterForm');
    const newsletterSuccess = document.getElementById('newsletterSuccess');

    newsletterForm.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      newsletterForm.style.display = 'none';
      newsletterSuccess.classList.add('visible');
    });

    // Smooth scroll for anchor links
    document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(anchor => {
      anchor.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        const target = document.querySelector(anchor.getAttribute('href'));
        if (target) {
          e.preventDefault();
          target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
        }
      });
    });
  </script>

    // Header scroll effect

    const mobileNav = document.getElementById('mobileNav');
    const mobileOverlay = document.getElementById('mobileOverlay');
    const mobileNavClose = document.getElementById('mobileNavClose');
    const mobileLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-link');

    function openMobileMenu() {
      mobileNav.classList.add('open');
      mobileOverlay.classList.add('open');
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    }
    function closeMobileMenu() {
      mobileNav.classList.remove('open');
      mobileOverlay.classList.remove('open');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }

    mobileMenuBtn.addEventListener('click', openMobileMenu);
    mobileNavClose.addEventListener('click', closeMobileMenu);
    mobileOverlay.addEventListener('click', closeMobileMenu);
    mobileLinks.forEach(link => link.addEventListener('click', closeMobileMenu));

    // Product Carousel
    const track = document.getElementById('carouselTrack');
    const prevBtn = document.getElementById('carouselPrev');
    const nextBtn = document.getElementById('carouselNext');
    const dotsContainer = document.getElementById('carouselDots');
    let currentSlide = 0;

    function getVisibleCards() {
      const w = window.innerWidth;
      if (w <= 480) return 1;
      if (w <= 768) return 2;
      if (w <= 1024) return 3;
      return 4;
    }

    function getTotalSlides() {
      const cards = track.children.length;
      const visible = getVisibleCards();
      return Math.max(1, cards - visible + 1);
    }

    function getSlideWidth() {
      if (!track.children[0]) return 0;
      const card = track.children[0];
      const style = getComputedStyle(track);
      const gap = parseInt(style.gap) || 24;
      return card.offsetWidth + gap;
    }

    function updateCarousel() {
      const total = getTotalSlides();
      if (currentSlide >= total) currentSlide = total - 1;
      if (currentSlide < 0) currentSlide = 0;
      const offset = currentSlide * getSlideWidth();
      track.style.transform = `translateX(-${offset}px)`;

      prevBtn.style.opacity = currentSlide === 0 ? '0.4' : '1';
      prevBtn.style.pointerEvents = currentSlide === 0 ? 'none' : 'auto';
      nextBtn.style.opacity = currentSlide >= total - 1 ? '0.4' : '1';
      nextBtn.style.pointerEvents = currentSlide >= total - 1 ? 'none' : 'auto';

      renderDots();
    }

    function renderDots() {
      const total = getTotalSlides();
      dotsContainer.innerHTML = '';
      for (let i = 0; i < total; i++) {
        const dot = document.createElement('button');
        dot.className = 'carousel-dot' + (i === currentSlide ? ' active' : '');
        dot.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Go to slide ' + (i + 1));
        dot.addEventListener('click', () => { currentSlide = i; updateCarousel(); });
        dotsContainer.appendChild(dot);
      }
    }

    prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { currentSlide--; updateCarousel(); });
    nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { currentSlide++; updateCarousel(); });
    window.addEventListener('resize', updateCarousel);
    updateCarousel();

    // Touch/swipe support for carousel
    let touchStartX = 0;
    let touchEndX = 0;
    track.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { touchStartX = e.changedTouches[0].screenX; }, { passive: true });
    track.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
      touchEndX = e.changedTouches[0].screenX;
      const diff = touchStartX - touchEndX;
      if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
        if (diff > 0) { currentSlide++; }
        else { currentSlide--; }
        updateCarousel();
      }
    }, { passive: true });

    // Store Locator
    const storeForm = document.getElementById('storeSearchForm');
    const storeResults = document.getElementById('storeResults');
    const zipInput = document.getElementById('zipInput');

    storeForm.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const zip = zipInput.value.trim();
      if (zip.length > 0) {
        storeResults.classList.add('visible');
        storeResults.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
      }
    });

    // Newsletter
    const newsletterForm = document.getElementById('newsletterForm');
    const newsletterSuccess = document.getElementById('newsletterSuccess');

      e.preventDefault();
      newsletterForm.style.display = 'none';
      newsletterSuccess.classList.add('visible');
    });

    // Smooth scroll for anchor links
    document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(anchor => {
      anchor.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        const target = document.querySelector(anchor.getAttribute('href'));
        if (target) {
          e.preventDefault();
          target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
        }
      });
    });
  </script>

      margin-bottom: 20px;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }

    .hero p {
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      color: var(--color-text-light);
      margin-bottom: 36px;
      max-width: 480px;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    .hero-buttons {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 14px 28px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .btn-primary {
      background: var(--color-primary);
      color: white;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(45,106,79,0.3);
    }

    .btn-primary:hover {
      background: var(--color-primary-dark);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(45,106,79,0.4);
    }

    .btn-secondary {
      background: var(--color-white);
      color: var(--color-primary);
      border: 2px solid var(--color-primary);
    }

    .btn-secondary:hover {
      background: var(--color-primary);
      color: white;
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    .hero-visual {
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .hero-image-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      grid-template-rows: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 16px;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 480px;
    }

    .hero-img-card {
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      aspect-ratio: 1;
      position: relative;
    }

    .hero-img-card:nth-child(1) { transform: translateY(-12px); }
    .hero-img-card:nth-child(4) { transform: translateY(12px); }

    .hero-img-placeholder {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 3rem;
      color: white;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .hero-img-card:nth-child(1) .hero-img-placeholder {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #A8E6CF, #88D8B0);
    }
    .hero-img-card:nth-child(2) .hero-img-placeholder {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFDAB9, #F4A261);
    }
    .hero-img-card:nth-child(3) .hero-img-placeholder {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFE4B5, #F4D35E);
    }
    .hero-img-card:nth-child(4) .hero-img-placeholder {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E8B4B8, #E76F51);
    }

    /* ========================================
       SECTION COMMON
       ======================================== */
    .section { padding: 80px 0; }

    .section-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }

    .section-header h2 {
      font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 3vw, 2.25rem);
      color: var(--color-primary-dark);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .section-header p {
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      color: var(--color-text-light);
      max-width: 560px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    /* ========================================
       FEATURED PRODUCTS CAROUSEL
       ======================================== */
    .featured-products {
      background: var(--color-white);
      padding: 80px 0;
    }

    .carousel-wrapper {
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .carousel-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 24px;
      transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
      padding: 8px 4px;
    }

    .product-card {
      flex: 0 0 calc(25% - 18px);
      min-width: 260px;
      background: var(--color-cream);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .product-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    }

    .product-img {
      height: 200px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 3.5rem;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .product-card:nth-child(1) .product-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFF3E0, #FFE0B2); }
    .product-card:nth-child(2) .product-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #F3E5F5, #E1BEE7); }
    .product-card:nth-child(3) .product-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FBE9E7, #FFCCBC); }
    .product-card:nth-child(4) .product-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E8F5E9, #C8E6C9); }
    .product-card:nth-child(5) .product-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFF8E1, #FFECB3); }
    .product-card:nth-child(6) .product-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFEBEE, #FFCDD2); }
    .product-card:nth-child(7) .product-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E0F7FA, #B2EBF2); }
    .product-card:nth-child(8) .product-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFF3E0, #FFE0B2); }

    .product-info {
      padding: 20px;
    }

    .product-name {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      color: var(--color-primary-dark);
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .product-desc {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: var(--color-text-muted);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      line-height: 1.5;
      display: -webkit-box;
      -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
      -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .product-price {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      color: var(--color-primary);
    }

    .carousel-btn {
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--color-white);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      z-index: 10;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      border: 2px solid var(--color-border);
    }

    .carousel-btn:hover {
      background: var(--color-primary);
      color: white;
      border-color: var(--color-primary);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    }

    .carousel-btn svg {
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
      stroke: currentColor;
      fill: none;
      stroke-width: 2.5;
      stroke-linecap: round;
      stroke-linejoin: round;
    }

    .carousel-btn-prev { left: -8px; }
    .carousel-btn-next { right: -8px; }

    .carousel-dots {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: 32px;
    }

    .carousel-dot {
      width: 10px;
      height: 10px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--color-border);
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .carousel-dot.active {
      background: var(--color-primary);
      width: 28px;
      border-radius: 5px;
    }

    /* ========================================
       SEASONAL PICKS
       ======================================== */
    .seasonal-picks {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E8F5E9 0%, var(--color-cream) 100%);
    }

    .seasonal-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr));
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .seasonal-card {
      background: var(--color-white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      transition: all var(--transition);
      position: relative;
    }

    .seasonal-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    }

    .seasonal-badge {
      position: absolute;
      top: 16px;
      left: 16px;
      background: var(--color-accent);
      color: white;
      padding: 4px 12px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      z-index: 2;
    }

    .seasonal-img {
      height: 180px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 3rem;
    }

    .seasonal-card:nth-child(1) .seasonal-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E8F5E9, #B2DFDB); }
    .seasonal-card:nth-child(2) .seasonal-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFF3E0, #FFCC80); }
    .seasonal-card:nth-child(3) .seasonal-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #EFEBE9, #D7CCC8); }
    .seasonal-card:nth-child(4) .seasonal-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFF8E1, #FFE082); }

    .seasonal-info {
      padding: 20px;
    }

    .seasonal-name {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      color: var(--color-primary-dark);
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .seasonal-desc {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: var(--color-text-muted);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    .seasonal-price {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      color: var(--color-primary);
    }

    /* ========================================
       CATEGORIES
       ======================================== */
    .categories-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .category-card {
      position: relative;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      aspect-ratio: 4/3;
      cursor: pointer;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .category-bg {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 3.5rem;
      transition: transform var(--transition);
    }

    .category-card:nth-child(1) .category-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFE0B2, #FFCC80); }
    .category-card:nth-child(2) .category-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #C8E6C9, #A5D6A7); }
    .category-card:nth-child(3) .category-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #B3E5FC, #81D4FA); }
    .category-card:nth-child(4) .category-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFCCBC, #FF8A65); }
    .category-card:nth-child(5) .category-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFF9C4, #FFF176); }

    .category-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(27,67,50,0.65);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity var(--transition);
      padding: 20px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .category-card:hover .category-bg { transform: scale(1.08); }
    .category-card:hover .category-overlay { opacity: 1; }

    .category-name {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      color: white;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .category-subtitle {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    /* Permanent bottom label visible without hover */
    .category-label {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(27,67,50,0.8), transparent);
      padding: 32px 16px 16px;
      transition: opacity var(--transition);
    }

    .category-card:hover .category-label { opacity: 0; }

    .category-label-text {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      color: white;
    }

    /* ========================================
       BRAND HIGHLIGHTS
       ======================================== */
    .highlights {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-primary-dark) 0%, var(--color-primary) 50%, var(--color-primary-light) 100%);
      padding: 64px 0;
      color: white;
    }

    .highlights-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 32px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .highlight-item {
      padding: 16px;
    }

    .highlight-number {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 900;
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem);
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      color: var(--color-accent);
    }

    .highlight-label {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1rem;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .highlight-desc {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      opacity: 0.8;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    /* ========================================
       STORE LOCATOR
       ======================================== */
    .store-locator {
      background: var(--color-white);
    }

    .locator-box {
      max-width: 640px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .search-form {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }

    .search-input {
      flex: 1;
      padding: 16px 20px;
      border: 2px solid var(--color-border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      font-size: 1rem;
      background: var(--color-cream);
      transition: border-color var(--transition);
      outline: none;
    }

    .search-input:focus {
      border-color: var(--color-primary);
    }

    .search-btn {
      padding: 16px 32px;
      background: var(--color-primary);
      color: white;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .search-btn:hover {
      background: var(--color-primary-dark);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .store-results {
      display: none;
    }

    .store-results.visible {
      display: block;
      animation: fadeSlideUp 0.4s ease;
    }

    @keyframes fadeSlideUp {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }

    .store-card {
      background: var(--color-cream);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 20px 24px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
      border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .store-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--color-primary);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .store-name {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1rem;
      color: var(--color-primary-dark);
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .store-address {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      color: var(--color-text-light);
      margin-bottom: 2px;
    }

    .store-hours {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: var(--color-text-muted);
    }

    .store-distance {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      color: var(--color-primary);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    /* ========================================
       NEWSLETTER
       ======================================== */
    .newsletter {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-cream) 0%, #E8F5E9 100%);
    }

    .newsletter-box {
      max-width: 520px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .newsletter-form {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-top: 32px;
    }

    .newsletter-input {
      flex: 1;
      padding: 16px 20px;
      border: 2px solid var(--color-border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      font-size: 1rem;
      background: var(--color-white);
      transition: border-color var(--transition);
      outline: none;
    }

    .newsletter-input:focus {
      border-color: var(--color-primary);
    }

    .newsletter-btn {
      padding: 16px 28px;
      background: var(--color-accent);
      color: white;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .newsletter-btn:hover {
      background: var(--color-accent-dark);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .newsletter-success {
      display: none;
      margin-top: 20px;
      padding: 16px;
      background: rgba(45,106,79,0.1);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      color: var(--color-primary);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
    }

    .newsletter-success.visible {
      display: block;
      animation: fadeSlideUp 0.4s ease;
    }

    /* ========================================
       FOOTER
       ======================================== */
    .footer {
      background: var(--color-primary-dark);
      color: white;
      padding: 64px 0 32px;
    }

    .footer-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 40px;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }

    .footer-col h4 {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1rem;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      color: var(--color-accent);
    }

    .footer-col ul {
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .footer-col a {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
      transition: color var(--transition);
    }

    .footer-col a:hover { color: white; }

    .footer-bottom {
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      padding-top: 24px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .footer-tagline {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
    }

    .footer-social {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .footer-social a {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
    }

    .footer-social a:hover {
      background: var(--color-accent);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    /* ========================================
       MOBILE NAV DRAWER
       ======================================== */
    .mobile-nav {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      right: -100%;
      width: 280px;
      height: 100vh;
      background: var(--color-white);
      z-index: 200;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
      transition: right var(--transition);
      padding: 80px 32px 32px;
    }

    .mobile-nav.open { right: 0; }

    .mobile-nav-overlay {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
      z-index: 199;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity var(--transition);
    }

    .mobile-nav-overlay.open { opacity: 1; }

    .mobile-nav-close {
      position: absolute;
      top: 20px;
      right: 20px;
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      color: var(--color-text);
    }

    .mobile-nav ul {
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .mobile-nav a {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      color: var(--color-primary-dark);
    }

    /* ========================================
       RESPONSIVE
       ======================================== */
    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .highlights-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .nav-links { display: none; }
      .mobile-menu-btn { display: flex; }
      .mobile-nav, .mobile-nav-overlay { display: block; }

      .hero-inner {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 40px;
        text-align: center;
      }

      .hero p { margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; }
      .hero-buttons { justify-content: center; }

      .hero-image-grid {
        max-width: 340px;
        margin: 0 auto;
      }

      .footer-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
        gap: 32px;
      }

      .search-form { flex-direction: column; }
      .newsletter-form { flex-direction: column; }

      .product-card { min-width: 220px; flex: 0 0 calc(50% - 12px); }

      .categories-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .section { padding: 60px 0; }
      .hero { padding: 60px 0 80px; }
      .highlights-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; }
      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .product-card { min-width: 200px; flex: 0 0 80%; }
      .categories-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .hero-buttons { flex-direction: column; align-items: center; }
      .footer-bottom { flex-direction: column; text-align: center; }
    }
  </style>

  <script>
    // Header scroll effect

    // Mobile menu
    const mobileMenuBtn = document.getElementById('mobileMenuBtn');
    const mobileNav = document.getElementById('mobileNav');
    const mobileOverlay = document.getElementById('mobileOverlay');
    const mobileNavClose = document.getElementById('mobileNavClose');
    const mobileLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-link');

    function openMobileMenu() {
      mobileNav.classList.add('open');
      mobileOverlay.classList.add('open');
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    }
    function closeMobileMenu() {
      mobileNav.classList.remove('open');
      mobileOverlay.classList.remove('open');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';

    mobileMenuBtn.addEventListener('click', openMobileMenu);
    mobileNavClose.addEventListener('click', closeMobileMenu);
    mobileOverlay.addEventListener('click', closeMobileMenu);
    mobileLinks.forEach(link => link.addEventListener('click', closeMobileMenu));

    // Product Carousel
    const track = document.getElementById('carouselTrack');
    const prevBtn = document.getElementById('carouselPrev');
    const nextBtn = document.getElementById('carouselNext');
    const dotsContainer = document.getElementById('carouselDots');
    let currentSlide = 0;

    function getVisibleCards() {
      const w = window.innerWidth;
      if (w <= 480) return 1;
      if (w <= 768) return 2;
      if (w <= 1024) return 3;
      return 4;
    }

    function getTotalSlides() {
      const cards = track.children.length;
      const visible = getVisibleCards();
      return Math.max(1, cards - visible + 1);
    }

    function getSlideWidth() {
      if (!track.children[0]) return 0;
      const card = track.children[0];
      const style = getComputedStyle(track);
      const gap = parseInt(style.gap) || 24;
      return card.offsetWidth + gap;
    }

    function updateCarousel() {
      const total = getTotalSlides();
      if (currentSlide >= total) currentSlide = total - 1;
      if (currentSlide < 0) currentSlide = 0;
      const offset = currentSlide * getSlideWidth();
      track.style.transform = `translateX(-${offset}px)`;

      prevBtn.style.opacity = currentSlide === 0 ? '0.4' : '1';
      prevBtn.style.pointerEvents = currentSlide === 0 ? 'none' : 'auto';
      nextBtn.style.opacity = currentSlide >= total - 1 ? '0.4' : '1';
      nextBtn.style.pointerEvents = currentSlide >= total - 1 ? 'none' : 'auto';

      renderDots();
    }

    function renderDots() {
      const total = getTotalSlides();
      dotsContainer.innerHTML = '';
      for (let i = 0; i < total; i++) {
        const dot = document.createElement('button');
        dot.className = 'carousel-dot' + (i === currentSlide ? ' active' : '');
        dot.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Go to slide ' + (i + 1));
        dot.addEventListener('click', () => { currentSlide = i; updateCarousel(); });
        dotsContainer.appendChild(dot);
      }
    }

    prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { currentSlide--; updateCarousel(); });
    nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { currentSlide++; updateCarousel(); });
    window.addEventListener('resize', updateCarousel);
    updateCarousel();

    // Touch/swipe support for carousel
    let touchStartX = 0;
    let touchEndX = 0;
    track.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { touchStartX = e.changedTouches[0].screenX; }, { passive: true });
    track.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
      touchEndX = e.changedTouches[0].screenX;
      const diff = touchStartX - touchEndX;
      if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
        if (diff > 0) { currentSlide++; }
        else { currentSlide--; }
        updateCarousel();
      }
    }, { passive: true });

    // Store Locator
    const storeForm = document.getElementById('storeSearchForm');
    const storeResults = document.getElementById('storeResults');
    const zipInput = document.getElementById('zipInput');

    storeForm.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const zip = zipInput.value.trim();
      if (zip.length > 0) {
        storeResults.classList.add('visible');
        storeResults.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
      }
    });

    // Newsletter
    const newsletterForm = document.getElementById('newsletterForm');
    const newsletterSuccess = document.getElementById('newsletterSuccess');

      newsletterForm.style.display = 'none';
      newsletterSuccess.classList.add('visible');
    });

    // Smooth scroll for anchor links
    document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(anchor => {
      anchor.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        const target = document.querySelector(anchor.getAttribute('href'));
        if (target) {
          e.preventDefault();
          target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
        }
      });
    });
